name: mugen-js
purpose: The engine the web version runs on: M.U.G.E.N 1.1 rebuilt for the browser in TypeScript and WebGL2.

note: Vendored rather than installed: the package has no npm release, building it from source needs its own toolchain, and a pinned bundle is what a browser actually loads. tools/validate.py hashes this file against these numbers, so replacing it is a deliberate act.
